title: I built my own Deriv + MT5 trading platform looking for a few people to test it
author: BuyParticular3433
selftext:
Been working on this project for a while and figured I’d finally show it here 😅

I built my own trading platform called KOOLKID. It started off as a Deriv bot, but I kept adding stuff to it and eventually built an MT5 Hub too.

Right now it has things like automated trading, EAs, copy trading/multiple accounts, cloud trading, manual trading tools and a bunch of strategies I’ve been testing.

I’m still improving it and honestly I need more real people testing it instead of me finding every bug myself 😂

So I’m giving out a few free MT5 trials right now. I’m not promising anybody guaranteed profits or anything like that — I just want traders to actually use it and give me honest feedback.

I attached a quick video showing some of what I’ve built.

If anybody wants to try it, just comment or DM me and I’ll help you get set up 👍

koolkidbot.org

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: copy trading across multiple accounts is where I'd test hardest. one account lagging a fill or getting rejected on margin while the others go through is the bug that actually costs testers money, and it never shows up when you test on a single demo account.

replies.author: BuyParticular3433
replies.body: I have tester with some brokers like deriv, hfm weltrade and all worked well but I am definitely still testing the limits of the copy trading. I do know different brokers have different rules so I will find them out and make adjustments to the bot to suite each broker.

comments.author: SpellIll9150
comments.body: I'd be down to try it out, I'd love to see a solo startup project expand honestly. I've kinda been wanting to get into trading and I'd like to throw some money down.
